recent_facts: Rhea interfaced Unit 734 with the dead tollbooth terminal.
The combat logs revealed the Debt Collectors cost Node Mana to spawn.
Rhea accessed the Mana Ledger and discovered the overseer's finite budget.
Rhea acquired the coordinates to the local administrative hub funding the attacks.

last_scene: The party sprinted down the Audit Corridor, facing a gauntlet of automated turrets firing 'Cease and Desist' bolts.
Vance used his Rebar to deflect incoming fire, acting as a meat shield while his HP dropped to a critical 5/100.
Unit 734 suffered severe collateral damage, its chassis integrity falling to 15%.
Rhea pushed through the crossfire and kicked open the mahogany double doors, successfully breaching the Overseer's Inner Office.
story_so_far: Vance tanked the regenerating guard's attacks, dropping to 10 HP.
Rhea fed her Obsidian Shard into the terminal, which partially consumed it and ejected it back into her hand.
Rhea sacrificed her Cracked Smartphone, Scrap Parchment, and Copper Credits to complete the audit.
The compliance check passed, deactivating the lasers and opening the blast door to the inner corridor.
The blast doors opened to reveal the heavily defended Audit Corridor.
Vance Harrow tanked multiple turret bolts, his HP dropping from 10 to 5.
Unit 734's chassis integrity dropped from 29% to 15% due to grazing hits.
Vance destroyed the final flanking turret with his Rebar.
Rhea kicked the mahogany doors off their hinges, confronting the overseer.
